# <span id="aanchor171"></span> CALCit Integrated

CALCit is an intuitive application that assists field and office personnel in performing gas and liquid flow measurement calculations. This application uses the latest industry standard calculations, allowing users to perform spot calculations for gas volume, plate size, liquid correction factors, speed of sound, and more. CALCit also assists in validating other systems, and allows users to view, save, and print the results of multiple calculations based on different input values.

CALCit Integrated makes CALCit accessible from FLOWCAL, including all of its calculators and associated functionality, depending on purchased licensing. The integrated package also includes the ability to populate a calculator from a selected gas meter's configuration.

For additional information, and to learn about all available CALCit calculators, please visit the <a href="https://resources.quorumsoftware.com/overviews/flow-and-quality-calculator-overview" class="InlineLink" target="_blank">CALCit product page</a> or contact <a href="mailto:flowcal.support@quorumsoftware.com" class="InlineLink">Customer Support</a>.
